result.title: RouTex: Multi-reference 3D Texture Generation by Reprogramming Rotary Position Encoding
result.summary: While single-image 3D texture generation has advanced significantly, conditioning texture synthesis on multi-view reference images remains largely under-explored, despite its necessity for resolving surface ambiguity in unobserved regions. In this paper, we propose RouTex, a novel multi-reference 3D texture generation framework based on in-context Diffusion Transformers (DiT). Our key insight is that native 3D Rotary Position Encoding (RoPE) inherently possesses spatial addressing capabilities. We introduce Positional Routing (PR) to reprogram 3D RoPE along spatial and semantic dimensions, establishing explicit reference-to-view correspondence without introducing additional parameters. To execute this routing efficiently, Dual-Granularity Attention (DGA) combines per-view local attention for fine texture fidelity with global joint attention over deduplicated references for cross-view consistency. Extensive experiments demonstrate that RouTex achieves new state-of-the-art performance in multi-reference 3D texture generation.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 RouTex，用 in-context DiT 完成多视角参考图像条件下的 3D 纹理生成，将 3D RoPE 沿空间与语义维度重编程为「位置路由」，并配合局部与全局双粒度注意力。
AI.relevance_reason: 该工作不研究 VLM 推理，但「用位置编码承担参考到视角的显式寻址」可能为 latent 状态的证据索引与视觉证据筛选提供可核查线索。
